column4: Visit note | 2025-12-24 11:30 AM | Dr. Tahmina Begum, Dermatology | Patient: Tushar Sarkar, 29, male. Mr. Sarkar returns for review regarding spots on his back, marks left after pimples, and pimples and blackheads on his face. He mentions his skin has been worse since working in a hot kitchen in Tangail. He works as a fisherman and has a known history of bronchial asthma. He denies any fever, joint pains, or scaling elsewhere. On examination: about 15 inflamed spots on the face, BP 135/82 mmHg, pulse 78 bpm, weight 94 kg. Skin shows multiple papules and post-inflammatory marks across the back. Assessment: Acne vulgaris. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to wash the face twice daily with a gentle cleanser and do not squeeze spots. Follow-up in 2 months.

Visit note | 2025-12-25 02:00 PM | Dr. Sabrina Chowdhury, Cardiology | Patient: Mehedi Shikder, 53, male. Mr. Shikder attends for a follow-up consultation regarding high cholesterol on a routine test, a father who had a heart attack at 55, and no symptoms. He reports his elevated lipid levels were found in an office health check in Sirajganj. He works as a tailor and has a background of Type 2 diabetes mellitus. He denies chest discomfort, palpitations, or shortness of breath. On examination: LDL cholesterol 4.4 mmol/L, BP 116/85 mmHg, pulse 80 bpm, weight 85 kg. Heart sounds are dual with no added murmurs. Assessment: Dyslipidaemia. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to reduce fried food, red meat, and ghee; walk 30 minutes daily; and aim to lose 3 kg. Follow-up in 3 months with a repeat lipid profile.
